diagnosis.media_identity_defect: DiscSource mounted authenticated BIN/CUE layout without deriving the authentic sector-4 license identity, so a reached GetID would have returned IdError.
diagnosis.path_defect: The prior probe stopped at copied BIOS shell entry 0x80030000 and incorrectly attempted a game binding; it had not executed the shell and therefore could not have issued CD MMIO or raw-sector reads.
